{{Otheruses|Chief Executive}}
{{Quote|The C-point CE declared a bug-out right after the first major flare incident, and the whole Exec Sec evaced along with practically all the C-point civpop.|Jenica Sonsen|<ref name="SAC">''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''</ref>}}
The '''Chief Executive''', sometimes referred to as the '''CE''', was the head of the [[Executive Secretariat]], a group that directly administered [[Centerpoint Station]] within the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].

==History==
{{Quote|I believe that what Administrative Officer Sonsen means is that Centerpoint's Chief Executive ordered a full evacuation after the first flare disaster, and the entire Executive Secretariat left along with most of the civilian populace.|C-3PO|<ref name="SAC" />}}
In [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]] the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], between which Centerpoint Station sat, formed the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]], which soon controlled the station.<ref name="SWG: Empire">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The Executive Secretariat came to directly administer Centerpoint, with the Chief Executive at its head. During the [[Corellian Crisis]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], a community within the station, [[Hollowtown]], was destroyed when Centerpoint's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] [[Destruction of TD-10036-EM-1271|fired]], as it was located within the station's tractor beam projector chamber, unbeknownst to the residents. The Chief Executive believed it to be a terrorist attack and ordered a full evacuation of the station, leaving only Chief [[Operations officer/Legends|Operations Officer]] [[Jenica Sonsen]] behind.<ref name="SAC" />
